description.value: Established in 1998, Locus is a long-standing fixture on Vancouver's Main Street — a funky, gothic-decored neighbourhood restaurant and lounge offering an eclectic fusion of globally inspired dishes built around seasonal, locally sourced ingredients. The kitchen rotates through daily brunch, lunch, happy hour, and dinner specials, with local wines and craft beers on offer throughout. Walk-ins are welcome, making it an easy drop-in along one of Vancouver's most active cycling corridors.
